_doc: Golden of the upstream post-processing steps of the BiRefNet α matte (generated by tools/export-recipes/birefnet/matte_fixture.py — ADR 0125).
It calls the upstream functions as they are, with only the quantization replaced by round-half-up (floor(x + 0.5)).

hr: numpy f64 σ → floor(255σ + 0.5) as uint8 → PIL.Image.fromarray(q) (L).resize((W, H)) (resample omitted = BICUBIC). The contract is 0 mismatches with TS's u8-pil-bicubic (the generator rejects samples whose 255σ is less than tieMargin from k + 0.5).

lucida: torch f32 sigmoid → torchvision.transforms.functional.resize(preds[0], (H, W)) (bilinear, antialias default) → × 255 (f32). The final α is floor(x + 0.5). TS's float-bilinear matches, or may be off by one step only where the golden's 255α is within epsilon of k + 0.5.
Tensors in matte.safetensors: `<input>.logits` (F32 [h, w]), `<case>.hr` (U8 [H, W]), `<case>.lucida` (F32 [H, W] — 255α before rounding).

The values are decided by the torch / torchvision / Pillow / numpy versions — regenerate when a version changes (the recipe's birefnet/tests/test_matte_fixture.py compares them with the current versions).
lucida's last bit also changes with the CPU instruction set — regenerate and compare on the reference environment (the development machine) (docs/limitations.md).
